description: Figure 8 presents an accuracy comparison between Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage, plotted on a line graph with accuracy on the y-axis and training step on the x-axis. The x-axis, labeled "Step", ranges from 0 to 60,000 and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", is scaled logarithmically from 10⁻¹ to 10⁰, with tick marks at intervals of 10⁻¹. The plot includes two lines: a blue line with circular markers representing Ex1 accuracy, which starts at approximately 0.99, decreases slightly to around 0.985, and then stabilizes near 0.98; and a green line with triangular markers representing Ex2 accuracy, which starts at approximately 0.99, decreases slightly to around 0.985, and then stabilizes near 0.98. Both lines show a similar trend of initial decline followed by stabilization at a high accuracy level.
